quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on Tyler Herro and Nate Williams injury updates
quotes.excerpt: Tyler is a little under the weather, wasn't here today. Hopefully he heals up and is back tomorrow.
quotes.quote: Tyler is a little under the weather, wasn't here today. Hopefully he heals up and is back tomorrow. Nate is progressing, a little bit more movement in the half court, but definitely kind of constrained there, but making some positive progress right now.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins provides injury updates on Tyler Herro and Nate Williams. Herro is out today while under the weather, while Williams is making positive progress but remains constrained in his movement.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on evaluating defensive effort and team consistency
quotes.excerpt: It's got to be an everyday thing behind closed doors, through the doors, over the doors.
quotes.quote: I think we got a lot of guys I'm trying to evaluate. I think they're going to get opportunities tomorrow in Game 4, and it's got to be an everyday thing behind closed doors, through the doors, over the doors, in between the doors, all the above. But I think those guys really kind of latching on to the defensive side, on-ball pressure, full court, size, physicality, I want to push those guys even more.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins says he is looking for more defensive intensity from his players. He wants to see more on-ball pressure and physicality as he continues to evaluate the roster ahead of Game 4.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on Nate Williams' availability for opening night
quotes.excerpt: He's on track making progress. Obviously we're doing everything possible to hopefully be available for opening night.
quotes.quote: Still TBD. He's on track making progress. Obviously we're doing everything possible to hopefully be available for opening night, but I think we'll have a better indication once we get through this week and we get through the weekend and what that final ramp up looks like Monday, Tuesday next week. Our goal is to obviously have him available, but currently right now, it's going well and we'll just see how he responds day to day.
quotes.social_post: Nate Williams' status for opening night remains TBD. Taylor Jenkins says the team is doing everything possible to get him ready, but they will have a better indication after the upcoming week of practice.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on preparing young players like Younge Claire
quotes.excerpt: For a young guy, it's really just studying the league, watching a lot of film.
quotes.quote: I don't think there's one way to prepare for an opponent, but with the plethora of information out there, we try to filter it to a simpler approach. It's player tendencies, it's game plan, it's game plan execution and discipline that we're going to ask him and his teammates to go out and do on a night-to-night basis. For a young guy, it's really just studying the league, watching a lot of film. Our staff and our video guys get that to these guys in advance. It's game minutes, it's tendencies of players, guys that maybe matched up with, with our offensive rebounding and our switching.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins on developing young players like Younge Claire: It is about simplifying information, studying the league, and focusing on game plan execution and player tendencies.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on the potential for three-guard lineups
quotes.excerpt: I'll continue to evaluate in the next week or so, obviously the nature of the roster.
quotes.quote: I'll continue to evaluate in the next week or so, obviously the nature of the roster as you said, trying to play a little bit bigger maybe the next game, just to get a different look there and developing the chemistry. I think it's going to be a work in progress. I don't think it's going to be finalized by opening night. I think there's going to be maybe pockets throughout the game where we're going to have guard lineups and that could happen by script or it could happen just by the nature of what the game reveals to you.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins says the team's rotation is a work in progress. He plans to experiment with different looks, including potential three-guard lineups, but notes that nothing will be finalized by opening night.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on Jaime's development and defensive growth
quotes.excerpt: I love the competitiveness of Jaime, getting him to be more exposed in the starting lineup.
quotes.quote: I love the competitiveness of Jaime, getting him to be more exposed in the starting lineup, seek that opportunity, seek those challenges. He and I have had great conversations about wanting to take the next step defensively. He's obviously in the first three matchups taking some difficult matchups and had some good moments and had some learning moments too. Regardless of where he ends up, starting, coming off the bench, I think he can make a significant impact for us, but I really want him to take that next step defensively.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins is challenging Jaime to take the next step defensively. Whether starting or coming off the bench, Jenkins believes Jaime can make a significant impact if he embraces the defensive challenge.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on the decision-making process with John
quotes.excerpt: It's a balance of organic and not formal meetings too.
quotes.quote: It's a balance of organic and not formal meetings too. After our games we're having touch base on a lot of different things. Obviously roster being towards the top of that list of course and difficult decision that we're going to have to make here by I think Monday. But then we're also having some formal meetings too. A lot of work was done even during the summer, so we're not just saying, hey, we've only been together for two weeks since camp started. We've done a lot of homework here, we've studied these guys, we're really thinking about what the future has for us and trying to get these important decisions right as best as possible.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins says the team faces difficult roster decisions by Monday. He notes that the front office has been doing homework all summer to ensure they get these important decisions right.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on the team's defensive focus heading into the season
quotes.excerpt: Our real test starts next Wednesday. I stress to them today the level of urgency.
quotes.quote: Our real test starts next Wednesday. I stress to them today the level of urgency and care factor they got to have even through the last week of preseason and the natural excitement that next Wednesday is going to bring. But we've got a lot to we got to clean up on defensive side and on the offensive side as well. So the rotations, I could see it being open still. It's open competition, should be our mentality all season long and when the guys earn it and are consistently giving us what we need every single night, it starts with me.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins says the rotation remains open competition heading into the season. He is stressing urgency to his team, noting that they still have plenty to clean up on both ends of the floor before next Wednesday.
